run_eval_episode: run a real-world evaluation episode for the Stretch robot pick-and-place task with the OVMM agent
run_eval_episode_test_pick: run the evaluation episode in test-pick mode to test grasping a specific object like a cup
run_eval_episode_dry_run: run the evaluation episode in dry-run mode to simulate actions without executing them on the robot
run_eval_episode_reset_nav: run the evaluation episode and reset the robot navigation to the origin position before starting
run_eval_episode_custom_object: run the evaluation episode with a custom pick object, start receptacle, and goal receptacle
